ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Affle 3i Limited's Q1 2026 Monitoring Agency Report confirms a material strategic reallocation of INR 297.42 crore from technology development to funding inorganic growth opportunities, a deviation approved by shareholders. While this significantly alters the original fund utilization plan, it avoids red flag concerns due to the explicit shareholder consent. A substantial INR 499.11 crore from the preferential issue remains unutilized and is currently held in conservative, liquid investments, primarily earmarked for future acquisitions.
